notes: Only n_o was assigned. All other fields are unassigned placeholders. Target correspondence is unresolved: the description can refer to the composite-quality painting-by-effort interaction (F(1,62)=5.99, p=.017), monetary-value interaction (F(1,59)=10.21, p=.002), direct continuous comparison (F(1,64)=5.26, p=.025), or perceived-effort/perceived-quality path (Z=5.32, p<.001). These are candidate tests, not selected extractions. Recruitment-count arithmetic: (21 women + 12 men) + (23 women + 10 men) = 33 non-experts + 33 experts = 66 recruited participants. These counts are not labelled final analytic groups; 66 is not entered as analytic N. No N was derived from degrees of freedom.
